versionImpact.rationale: Buildchain v2.10 patch release accepts strict publish-gate channel-lineage PRs and supports externally managed web-surface directory-index rewrites for shared CloudFront preview routers.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: Accepts same-line publish-gate/alpha and publish-gate/release source-lock PR lineage during promote-buildchain-ref governance checks.

Allows web-surface deploy channels to declare directory_index_rewrite = external so Buildchain does not replace an existing viewer-request prefix router while health checks still validate root and nested surface URLs.

summary: Buildchain v2.10 patch release for publish-gate lineage and externally managed web-surface preview root routing.
